texts.li: [predator,watched] {X_nameDef} is still here. The {X_kind} the colony has been watching for days keeps to the trees by day and comes down toward the pens at dusk, and {A_nameDef}, who gave it its name, has started leaving the lamp burning. It has taken nothing of the colony's yet.\n\nThe council could leave it something to eat and see what comes of it, keep everyone close until it moves on, send the hunters, let {A_nameDef} try to win it over, or drive it off and have done.

[grazer,watched] {X_nameDef}, the {X_kind} that grazes the colony's far meadow every morning, has not moved on with the season as its kind do. {A_nameDef} named it and the name has stuck; the children point it out from the wall.\n\nThe council could leave it fodder and make a friend of it, send the hunters while it's fat, let {A_nameDef} try to tame it, or drive it off before it takes to the fields.

[fed,asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} comes for what the colony leaves out now, and waits at the edge of the trees for it. {A_nameDef} swears it knows {A_objective} by sight. A wild thing fed is half a tame one, and half a danger.\n\nThe council can go on feeding it, stop, send the hunters, let {A_nameDef} try to tame it in earnest, or drive it off.

[feared,asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} is still out there, and the colony has been keeping close because of it. Nobody has been hurt. Nobody has been easy, either.\n\nThe council can keep the watch up, send the hunters and end it, let {A_nameDef} try to win it over, or drive it off.

[asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} is still on the colony's land. By now everyone has a story about it, and {A_nameDef} has a name for the place it sleeps.\n\nWhat the colony does about it is the council's to say.

li.label: Leave food out for it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried food out to the edge of the trees for {X_nameDef} and left it there, and went back the long way round. By morning it was gone.

li.label: Keep everyone close until it moves on
li.outcome: The word went round: children inside by dusk, nobody alone past the fields, and {B_nameDef} at the gate tonight with a lamp and a gun. {X_nameDef} is out there, and the colony knows it.

li.label: Send the hunters after {X_nameDef}
li.outcome: The hunters went out after {X_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} said nothing, and watched them go from the wall.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} try to tame it
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is on the handlers' list, and {A_nameDef} has gone out to the edge of the trees with a bucket and a great deal of patience.

li.label: Let it be
li.outcome: The council let {X_nameDef} be. It is part of the land, for now, and the colony will go on pointing it out from the wall.

li.label: Drive it off
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} and another went out at dusk with torches and a great deal of noise, and {X_nameDef} went before them into the trees and over the edge of the land.

ColonyCouncil.DilemmaDef.label: the beast that stays, held sacred

texts.li: [predator,watched] {X_nameDef} is still here. The {X_kind} keeps to the trees by day and comes down toward the pens at dusk, and {A_nameDef} will not hear a word against it: {A_pronoun} says it is {GOD}'s, and that a beast of {GOD}'s is not the colony's to hunt or to drive off.\n\nThe council could leave it be as {A_nameDef} asks, leave it something to eat, keep everyone close until it moves on, send the hunters all the same, let {A_nameDef} try to win it over, or drive it off.

[grazer,watched] {X_nameDef}, the {X_kind} that grazes the colony's far meadow every morning, has not moved on with the season as its kind do, and {A_nameDef} says that is because it is {GOD}'s and the land suits it. {A_pronoun} has asked that nobody lay a hand on it.\n\nThe council could leave it be as {A_nameDef} asks, leave it fodder, keep everyone close, send the hunters while it's fat, let {A_nameDef} try to tame it, or drive it off before it takes to the fields.

[fed,asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} comes for what the colony leaves out now, and waits at the edge of the trees for it. {A_nameDef} says {GOD} sees every scrap of it, and that the colony could do worse than keep it so.\n\nThe council can leave it be as {A_nameDef} asks, go on feeding it, keep everyone close, send the hunters, let {A_nameDef} try to tame it in earnest, or drive it off.

[feared,asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} is still out there, and the colony has been keeping close because of it. {A_nameDef} has said more than once that a beast of {GOD}'s means nobody any harm, and that the hunters had better leave it alone.\n\nThe council can leave it be as {A_nameDef} asks, keep the watch up, send the hunters and end it, let {A_nameDef} try to win it over, or drive it off.

[asked2|asked3] {X_nameDef} is still on the colony's land. By now everyone has a story about it, and {A_nameDef} has one more than most: {A_pronoun} holds that it is {GOD}'s, and goes out to look at it most evenings.\n\nWhat the colony does about it is the council's to say.

li.label: Leave it be, as {A_nameDef} asks: it is not ours to hunt
li.outcome: The council let {X_nameDef} be. That evening {A_nameDef} walked out to the edge of the trees and stood a while within sight of it, and came back saying it was {GOD}'s and the colony had done right.

li.label: Leave food out for it
li.outcome: {A_nameDef} carried food out to the edge of the trees for {X_nameDef} and left it there, and said a few words over it before coming back. By morning it was gone.

li.label: Keep everyone close until it moves on
li.outcome: The word went round: children inside by dusk, nobody alone past the fields, and {B_nameDef} at the gate tonight with a lamp and a gun. {A_nameDef} said it was a fuss over nothing.

li.label: Send the hunters after {X_nameDef} all the same
li.outcome: The hunters went out after {X_nameDef}. {A_nameDef} would not watch them go.

li.label: Let {A_nameDef} try to tame it
li.outcome: {X_nameDef} is on the handlers' list, and {A_nameDef} has gone out to the edge of the trees with a bucket and a great deal of patience, saying {GOD} will decide whether it comes.

li.label: Drive it off
li.outcome: {B_nameDef} went out at dusk with a torch and a great deal of noise, and {X_nameDef} went before {B_objective} into the trees and over the edge of the land. {A_nameDef} stayed in.
